goal: Review API contract changes (OpenAPI, protobuf, GraphQL schemas and their route handlers) for breaking change…
use: Review API contract changes (OpenAPI, protobuf, GraphQL schemas and their route handlers) for breaking changes, versioning and deprecation errors, schema-to-implementation drift and inconsistent error handling. Use when an API schema or endpoint changes, or before a release that changes an external interface.

steps.note: Map. For each chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees only that chunk file and the "Chunk task" below.
Report. Write the report in the format below.

protocol.title: Inspect
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py scan <corpus>`. Note the file count, line count and top-level folders. If the corpus is very large, agree the scope with the user, then narrow it with `--include '<folder>'` (repeatable) on every command. Files over 20 MB are skipped; `--max-bytes N` changes the limit. Report what `scan` lists as skipped.

protocol.title: Partition
protocol.text: Run `WORK=$(mktemp -d)`, then `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py chunk <corpus> "$WORK/chunks"`. Chunks are limited to 800 lines and 100,000 characters each, and are cut between definitions where possible. Each `chunk_NNN.md` holds the data notice and labelled file sections. `manifest.json` lists the chunks.

protocol.title: Map
protocol.text: For each chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees only that chunk file and the "Chunk task" below. It writes `"$WORK/out/<chunk>.out.md"`. If you cannot start sub-tasks, run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py pending "$WORK/chunks" "$WORK/out"`. It lists the chunks that still have no output. Process the first one: read it, write its output, then run `pending` again. Repeat until nothing is pending. Never hold all chunks in context at once.

protocol.title: Reduce
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py merge "$WORK/out" --out "$WORK/merged.json"`. If it lists `failed_outputs`, re-run those chunks. A missing or invalid output is not "no findings". Checks that span files (a duplicate across manifests, a route missing from a contract, a pattern repeated across chunks) are done on the merged list in this step. If the merged list is still too large to read, repeat steps 2 to 4 on the findings.

protocol.title: Verify
protocol.text: Re-read each cited line. Do not call a change safe because a consumer probably ignores the field; state the assumption. Run a compatibility checker (oasdiff, buf breaking, graphql-inspector) once in the reduce step if one is installed, and record its output.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: Write the report in the format below.

protocol.title: Clean up
protocol.text: Delete `$WORK` after the report is delivered.
